# AI Masters Academy

> AI Masters Academy is a training institute offering six job-focused courses: Python Full-Stack Development, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, Cyber Security, UI/UX Designing and Digital Marketing. Learning is project-based with mentor reviews, career support and classroom, live online or weekend batches.

## Course pages
- [Python Fullstack Development](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/python-full-stack-development.html): 6 months, beginner friendly. Build complete web applications, from the database to the screen, using Python and modern web tools.
- [Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/artificial-intelligence-machine-learning.html): 7 months, basic python needed. Understand how models learn, then train, evaluate and deploy your own machine learning systems.
- [Data Science](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/data-science.html): 6 months, beginner friendly. Turn raw data into decisions: clean it, analyse it, model it and present it clearly.
- [Cyber Security](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/cyber-security.html): 6 months, basic networking helps. Learn to find weaknesses and protect systems, networks and applications in realistic lab environments.
- [UI/UX Designing](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/ui-ux-designing.html): 4 months, no design background needed. Research users, design clear interfaces and test prototypes until they are easy to use.
- [Digital Marketing](https://YOUR-DOMAIN/courses/digital-marketing.html): 4 months, no prior experience needed. Plan, run and measure campaigns that bring in real customers across search, social and email.

## Career support
Resume and LinkedIn help, portfolio reviews, mock interviews and job application guidance.
